name: @local/dsh-web-search-exa
description: Exa-backed search provider for the DSH web seam (ctx.web). Local rebuild of @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-exa@0.2.2-rc.1 with the pinned DSH version range removed, so it is self-contained and loads across dsh releases (no version constraint; last verified on 0.2.2-rc.5), with multi-key rotation and cooldown across several Exa teams.
